cues: Each food has its enzymes, bile only emulsifies, and villi absorb, sugars into blood and fats into the lacteals.
Breathing is Boyle's law, and the Bohr effect unloads oxygen where it is needed.
The circulation is double and closed, paced by the S A node, with cardiac output equal to stroke volume times rate.
Nephrons filter one hundred and eighty litres a day and take back ninety nine percent.
The impulse jumps from minus seventy to plus thirty five, all or none.
And hormones work by feedback: only insulin lowers blood sugar, and an L H surge triggers ovulation.
